title: I Printed the Dating-Profile Age Filter He Set After Asking Mine

parts.text: I was on a second date at 7:48 p.m. when he asked my age again, slowly, like I had lied. I am thirty-two. I had already shown him the profile. Later he left his phone face up while he paid. The app's filter was 23 to 29. I was not in the room he had built. I was twenty minutes into dessert. I photographed my own lap, not his screen, then asked him to show the filter if age mattered so much. He paled. At 7:52 he said it was an old setting, and the waiter asked whether we wanted the check split.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The waiter is holding the check and the filter still says 23 to 29.

social.video_title: He asked my age with a filter that excluded me — Part 1/2
social.description: Second date, dessert, 23–29. He called it old. Would you have split?

parts.text: I split. I unmatched on the sidewalk. He texted that settings are not values. Settings are the only values an app has. I blocked. Dessert was good. I set my own filter to people who can read a number they asked for. Thirty-two is not a glitch. Old settings are still current until you touch them. He had not touched them. I touched the door.

social.description: Split check, unmatched, blocked. Was 23–29 an accident?
